strings.name: Anne Lacaton
strings.summary: Lacaton trained in architecture and urban planning in Bordeaux and founded a practice with Jean-Philippe Vassal. They advocate observing and preserving existing buildings, then improving living conditions through extensions, winter gardens and balconies, emphasizing users’ spatial freedom. She has worked on social housing, cultural facilities and educational projects, often with other architects, and shared the 2021 Pritzker Prize with Vassal.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Preserve and extend
strings.highlights.h1.text: Extensions improve existing housing, reduce demolition and respect continuity in residents’ lives.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Shared Pritzker Prize
strings.highlights.h2.text: Shared the 2021 award with Vassal for sustained work on architectural renewal and spatial quality.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Shares Pritzker Prize
strings.timeline.t1.text: Shared the 2021 prize with Vassal; the jury recognized their social and ecological approach.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Transforms Grand Parc housing
strings.timeline.t2.text: With Vassal, Druot and Hutin, transformed 530 Bordeaux homes by adding balconies and winter gardens.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Expands Palais de Tokyo
strings.timeline.t3.text: With Vassal, transformed the Paris cultural institution, retaining its structure and expanding usable space.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Transforms Bois-le-Prêtre tower
strings.timeline.t4.text: With Vassal and Druot, added space and improved the performance of the Paris housing tower.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Completes Latapie House
strings.timeline.t5.text: With Vassal, used greenhouse construction to provide flexible climatic space within a limited housing budget.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Co-founds practice
strings.timeline.t6.text: Established a Paris practice with Vassal, designing housing and public buildings.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Earns urban planning master’s
strings.timeline.t7.text: Continued urban planning studies in Bordeaux, broadening her understanding of buildings and cities.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completes architectural training
strings.timeline.t8.text: Graduated from architecture school in Bordeaux, where she met her future collaborator Vassal.
